use: Exact title, archive and original architectural drawing attributed to Verrier (catalogue 40284).
First tower overall height of 22.3 m, date in early April 1734, later lighthouse histories and timber lantern with slate roof.

Research from Parks Canada’s Canadian Historic Sites series. Documents coursed stone construction, the approximately 400 panes of the original timber lantern and the fire on the night of 11–12 September 1736.
Mapped location of the original lighthouse ruins.
